meta.name: classification-modeling
meta.description: Build binary and multiclass classification models using logistic regression, decision trees, and ensemble methods for categorical prediction and classification

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用逻辑回归、决策树等方法构建分类模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用机器学习做分类预测
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build classification models for categorical prediction

howto.what: Claude 能构建二分类和多分类模型，使用逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林、梯度提升等算法，并输出分类指标、混淆矩阵、ROC曲线、特征重要性等结果。
howto.when: 当你需要预测分类结果，如客户流失、贷款违约、邮件垃圾识别，或需要将物品分到多个类别时触发。

say.text: 用逻辑回归预测客户流失概率。
say.note: Claude 会训练模型并输出性能指标。

say.text: 对这份数据进行多类别分类。
say.note: Claude 会选择合适的算法并给出结果。

say.text: 分析随机森林的特征重要性。
say.note: Claude 会从模型中提取特征重要性排序。

howto.what_en: Claude can build binary and multiclass classification models using logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, gradient boosting, etc., and output classification metrics, confusion matrices, ROC curves, feature importance, and other results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to predict categorical outcomes such as customer churn, loan default, email spam, or classify items into multiple categories.

say_en.text: Predict customer churn probability using logistic regression.
say_en.note: Claude will train the model and output performance metrics.

say_en.text: Perform multiclass classification on this data.
say_en.note: Claude will select an appropriate algorithm and produce results.

say_en.text: Analyze feature importance from random forest.
say_en.note: Claude will extract feature importance rankings from the model.
